A new call executes the current method generation

Native operations preserve accepted call order across multiple host budgets
Every scalar event retains its value and revision across multiple event budgets

Queued source deletion invalidates its subscription
Freed Godot owners cannot deliver queued values or retain native callback authority

Repeated stop preserves finalized native service state
